blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The easterlies, or warm winds coming from the Pacific Ocean, may bring gloomy skies and occasional rains over Northern Luzon, while the rest of the country may experience localized thunderstorms on Tuesday, Sept. 15, the state weather bureau reported.
